October 9, 2026


## Raising our Teekay flag to new heights and continents, together.


What started as a personal bucket list item for Additional Master Alexander Lyakhov, quickly turned into something bigger. Fuelled with determination and pride, our Teekay flag was carried all the way to the summit of the highest peak in Europe! But its journey didn’t stop there…


The flag made its rounds through various mountain peaks and Teekay offices, getting signed by all of us. Now, it’s covered in names of our global Teekay family, standing as a powerful reminder that our #TeekaySPIRIT knows no boundaries.


This flag represents our shared heartbeat in conquering imaginable feats as we take genuine pride in each other’s successes and celebrate every win as one team.
